messages.subject: Re: Rattle graphics crash
messages.body_plain:
Hi Graham,

Thanks for your assistance. In fact I already had GTK/Glade installed from my previous installation. But I redownloaded the GTK installer following your link, reinstalled and rattle is now working just fine. I probably had a too old version of gtk.

I also checked my initial problem with rattle (crashes when displaying graphs) and it also seems to be all right.

Many thanks for your help !

Rodo

Graham Williams <Graham....@togaware.com> wrote:
>
> Hi Rodo,
>
> This looks like you don't have the Gtk library installed on your
> system? (It is independent of R and rattle.)
>
> You seem to be using MS/Windows. So could you let me know if you have
> installed glade for windows from
>
> http://gladewin32.sourceforge.net/modules/news/
>
> You need to download gtk-dev-2.10.11-win32-1.exe and then run this
> self installing archive.
>
> The install instructions for Rattle are at
>
> http://datamining.togaware.com/survivor/Installation_Details.html
>
> Let me know how you go.
>
> Regards,
> Graham
>
>
>
>
> Received Fri 30 Nov 2007 7:08pm +1100 from Rodolphe Benes:
> > Hi,
> >
> > I am now having problems re-installing rattle().
> >
> > -I updated R to version 2.6.1 (OK).
> >
> > -I reinstalled RCmdr to upgrade to version 1.3.9 by doing Packages>install packages/Rcmdr (OK)
> >
> > -I reinstalled rattle to upgrade to version 2.2.64
> >
> > I also reinstalled package Rgtk2 from CRAN.
> >
> > But rattle won't start. See dialog below.
> >
> > Any idea someone?
> >
> > Thx
> > Rodo
> >
> > ----
> >
> > > local({pkg <- select.list(sort(.packages(all.available = TRUE)))
> > + if(nchar(pkg)) library(pkg, character.only=TRUE)})
> > Loading required package: tcltk
> > Loading Tcl/Tk interface ... done
> > Loading required package: car
> >
> > Rcmdr Version 1.3-9
> >
> > > utils:::menuInstallLocal()
> > package 'rattle' successfully unpacked and MD5 sums checked
> > updating HTML package descriptions
> > > local({pkg <- select.list(sort(.packages(all.available = TRUE)))
> > + if(nchar(pkg)) library(pkg, character.only=TRUE)})
> > Rattle, Graphical interface for data mining using R, Version 2.2.64.
> > Copyright (C) 2007 Graham....@togaware.com, GPL
> > Type "rattle()" to shake, rattle, and roll your data.
> > > rattle()
> > Error in dyn.load(file, ...) :
> > unable to load shared library 'C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-26~1.1/library/RGtk2/libs/RGtk2.dll':
> > LoadLibrary failure: The specified procedure could not be found.
> >
> >
> > Warning in fun(...) :
> > Failed to load RGtk2 dynamic library:Error in dyn.load(file, ...) :
> > unable to load shared library 'C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-26~1.1/library/RGtk2/libs/RGtk2.dll':
> > LoadLibrary failure: The specified procedure could not be found.
> >
> >
> >
> > [1] "PLEASE RESTART R BEFORE TRYING TO LOAD THE PACKAGE AGAIN"
> > Error in .C("R_gtkInit", length(args), x = args, PACKAGE = "RGtk2") :
> > C symbol name "R_gtkInit" not in DLL for package "RGtk2"
> > Error : .onLoad failed in 'loadNamespace' for 'RGtk2'
> > Error in rattle() : could not find function "gladeXMLNew"
> >
> >
> >
> > Graham Williams  wrote:
> > Hi Rodo,
> >
> > Thanks for the bug report.
> >
> > These are quite old versions of R and rattle. I had heard of some
> > issue if both Rcmdr and Rattle are running. Are you using the Cairo
> > graphics (I can't remember if back then Cairo was being used).
> >
> > I would recommend upgrading both R and Rattle to the latest versions
> > if you are able to. It is now a lot more stable.
> >
> > Let me know how you go.
> >
> > Regards,
> > Graham
> >
> > Received Wed 28 Nov 2007 1:52am +1100 from Rodolphe Benes:
> > > Hi,
> > >
> > > I have a lot of crashes when drawing plots with Rattle (Win XP + R v2.3.1+ Rcmdr v 1.2-1 + Rattle 2.1.119 ) .
> > >
> > > For example:
> > >
> > > I open a CSV data set (A small one. 10*700).
> > > Then I load data, then create a testing dataset and when I want to explore the data visualy (histogram, distribution plot,etc) I manage to plot once or twice (the couple of first variables I try). Then, when I try to plot distributions for more variables, rattle systematically crashes: i.e. white window and nothing else happening. The strange thing is that the application is not flagged as "not responding" in the windows task manager.
> > >
> > > Any idea?
> > >
> > > Thx
> > >
> > > Rodo
> > >
> > >
> > >
> > > >
> >
> >
> >
> >
> > >
>
>
>
